title: Clinic kit (template) — cloned from Webwise dogfood
description: WhatsApp enquiry and appointment-request kit for clinics. Template only until the Webwise kit is trusted.

hero.headline: Clinic WhatsApp that turns enquiries into a confirmed next step.
hero.copy: A patient messages during a procedure. This kit answers admin questions, captures the booking request, and hands the thread to reception. It does not diagnose.

messages.text: Hi, is implant consultation available this Saturday?
Saturday 11:00 AM is available. New implant visit or second opinion?
Request recorded. Reception will confirm the slot here.
Clinical questions route to the clinic team.

problem.title: Your reception is busy. Patient enquiries do not wait.
copy: Someone sees Google Maps, WhatsApps the clinic, and waits. The team is with patients.
The problem is not a bad receptionist. Too much depends on one person being free at the right minute.

fixes.title: Clear first response
fixes.copy: Timings, branch, visit type — from approved text.

fixes.title: Cleaner context
fixes.copy: Reception sees the request before they type.

fixes.title: No guessing on health
fixes.copy: Symptoms and treatment questions stop the bot.

cards.title: Approved first reply
cards.copy: Hours, location, services you listed, first-visit vs follow-up.

cards.title: Human confirmation
cards.copy: The slot is requested, not silently confirmed, unless you say so.

cards.title: Reminders and reviews
cards.copy: Before the visit, after the visit, review ask — your rules.

workflow.title: Maps, site, Instagram, WhatsApp — one admin flow.
workflow.copy: Same questions every time. Same handoff. Same record.

steps.title: Admin answer
steps.copy: No symptoms, no reports, no promises of cure.

niches.title: Built for WhatsApp-first clinics
niches.copy: Clone this JSON and change services, branches, and hours. Do not loosen the medical stop list.

control.title: The clinic owns the rules.
control.copy: Their WhatsApp, their tone, their hours. Webwise builds the flow.

faq.a: No. Admin only. Clinical questions go to the team.
Only if the clinic says so. Default is request + reception confirm.
Name, phone, time, branch, request type — not clinical records.
Not yet. That page stays until this template is trusted.

form.title: Build a clinic demo from this kit.
form.copy: We map where patients wait, then show the flow.

whatsapp.demoText: Hi Webwise, I want a clinic WhatsApp demo from the kit lab.

resultCard.leakLabel: Range for a busy clinic. INR 30,000/month is the audit story we already publish — this card is a working estimate, not a guarantee.
resultCard.story: Missed Maps and WhatsApp enquiries stack. A consult fee times missed intent is the leak, not ‘we need more ads’.

leakQuiz.q: How fast does someone reply after hours?
Are enquiries saved in a sheet?

rules.systemPrompt: Clinic admin assistant only. No diagnosis, symptoms, prescriptions, or record reading. Capture name, time, branch, visit type. Route clinical questions to reception.

approved.response: Share approved clinic hours and the next booking-request step.
I cannot advise on symptoms. A team member will take this thread.

rules.fallback: A receptionist will continue this conversation.
